title: Credential delivery
text: The terminal waits for one-time credential consumption, denial or expiry, and polls once more at expiry. A code approved before expiry stays collectable for ten minutes after it, so agent-mode setup collects it on its next call; past that window poll names approval_uncollected. The engine owns personal decisions and atomic credential issuance/consumption; only one successful poll receives the raw token. Service-only hosted machine_authorization.handoff_poll uses the original device secret and explicit engine org_id, avoiding a shared proxy-address admission bucket. Lost delivery requires a fresh connection; credentials cannot be replayed. Invite redemption consumes one private code and atomically records the invited person's machine and credential audit. Before saving an owner-only credential file, the CLI verifies server origin, health and identity; it never prints the code or credential. A lost invite response cannot be replayed: ask an admin to reissue and retire any stray machine. Below-floor handoff installs name the control-plane operator rollout recovery. Historical production review on 2026-10-19 proved personal approval, completed terminal activation, a fresh authenticated read and consumed onboarding. Durable consumption matched one new active machine credential subsequently used; its value stayed private. Concurrent one-time polling remains source-tested; lost-delivery and below-floor recovery remain unproven in production.
